title_vi: CDN (mạng phân phối nội dung) là gì?

source_snapshot.note: Fetched the pinned commit from GitHub; git rev-parse of the path gives the source map's blob OID. Non-empty source body read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Đường đi của một yêu cầu qua CDN: tìm máy biên rồi hỏi dần lên máy gốc.
Các chiến lược bộ đệm; CDN là một bộ đệm đọc dùng chung.

claims.evidence: Statements were checked against cloudflare/cloudflare-docs at commit 2ab084e257fef531e4e22a10c9a6feab7b3a4fce, nginx/nginx.org at commit 0ebe7b53ff30e8c4fbf348881b4c8bcec3cf27cb and mdn/content at commit a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a, read from partial clones, and against an experiment run on 2026-10-18 with Ubuntu's nginx 1.24.0 as the edge in front of a Python origin that counted bytes sent. Latency and attacks were not tested.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright 1.56, headless) rendered lesson.md converted by markdown-it (CommonMark, tables, raw HTML) with a 16 px page gutter and every <details> open, at 320, 375 and 430 px: document scrollWidth equalled the viewport at each width. Smallest figure text from the SVG font sizes times the shown scale: 13.5 px at 320, 15.0 px at 375. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser measured every figure line. Not GitHub's renderer, not a real phone, not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: A reverse proxy such as Cloudflare's CDN means a site never needs to reveal its origin IP address, making targeted attacks harder; it also caches content near users.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone; not tested.

claims.claim_vi: Cloudflare provides DDoS protection at layers 3, 4 and 7 through an autonomous edge that detects and mitigates attacks.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone; not tested.

claims.claim_vi: Always Online serves a stale or expired cached version when the origin is unreachable, falls back to the Internet Archive, and cannot serve dynamic content while the origin is offline.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone; not tested on Cloudflare.

claims.claim_vi: s-maxage overrides max-age in shared caches and is ignored by browsers; stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error let a cache serve stale content, and are ignored when Always Online is on.
proxy_cache_use_stale decides in which cases (error, timeout, http_502 and others) nginx may serve a stale cached response.
claims.verified_by: Read; in the experiment, with the origin stopped and the copy expired, the plain edge answered 502 Bad Gateway (EXPIRED) and the edge with proxy_cache_use_stale error timeout answered 200 (STALE).

claims.claim_vi: Experiment: 100 requests for a 200000-byte image straight to the origin made it send 20000000 bytes; 100 requests through the edge with public, max-age=5 made it send 200000 bytes once.
claims.verified_by: Own measurement; the URL documents shared caches and the public and private directives the experiment relied on.

design_notes_vi: Bốn thẻ lợi ích, mỗi thẻ kèm điều kiện; bốn ghi chú kết quả thử với nginx. Vẽ bằng scripts/figures.
source_deviations: Source lists four benefits without conditions; the lesson attaches the condition each one needs (content cached, shareable, origin address hidden, stale serving configured) and tests two of them.
Source says CDN improves security against DDoS; the lesson adds, from the Cloudflare docs, that this relies on not exposing the origin address.

Source says the CDN delivers static and dynamic content; the lesson notes that content marked private or no-store is not cached and that Always Online cannot serve dynamic content while the origin is down.
